/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.donvi,
    main.tong_nhan_su,
		main.tong_nhiem_vu AS tong_nhiem_vu,
    main.kpi_current,
    main.kpi_prev,
    main.kpi_current - main.kpi_prev AS kpi_trend
FROM (
    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.donvi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.canbo_id) AS tong_nhan_su,
				SUM(tongso) AS tong_nhiem_vu,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_current,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh_thangtruoc), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh_thangtruoc), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_prev

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_cbcc_danhgia_new_rt t
    GROUP BY t.monthkey, t.donvi

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        'Tất cả đơn vị' AS donvi,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.canbo_id) AS tong_nhan_su,
				SUM(tongso) AS tongso,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_current,

        ROUND(
            (
                (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + (100 * IFNULL(SUM(daht_thangtruoc) / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0))
                + IFNULL(
                    100 * (IFNULL(SUM(daht_dh_thangtruoc), 0) + IFNULL(SUM(daht_qh_thangtruoc), 0) * 0.75)
                    / NULLIF(SUM(tongso_thangtruoc), 0), 0
                )
            ) / 3, 1
        ) AS kpi_prev

    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_cbcc_danhgia_new_rt t
    GROUP BY t.monthkey
) main;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_don_vi_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
/* ===== THIẾT LẬP THÁNG ===== */
SET @monthkey = CAST(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') AS UNSIGNED);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__stg;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,
    /* ===== tổng hợp ===== */
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0))
      + IFNULL(t_now.tongso,0)
      AS tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0))
      AS nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,

    IFNULL(t_now.tongso,0)
      AS nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,

    /* ===== đã hoàn thành ===== */
    IFNULL(t_now.daht,0)     AS da_hoan_thanh,
    IFNULL(t_now.daht_dh,0)  AS da_hoan_thanh_dung_han,
    IFNULL(t_now.daht_qh,0)  AS da_hoan_thanh_qua_han,

    /* ===== đang thực hiện ===== */
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth,0)      AS dang_thuc_hien,
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth_th,0)   AS dang_thuc_hien_trong_han,
    IFNULL(t_now.dangth_qh,0)   AS dang_thuc_hien_qua_han,
		NOW()

FROM
(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN
(
    /* ===== danh sách cán bộ từ dm_user ===== */
    SELECT
        canbo_id,
        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,
        loaicap,
        iddv,
        donvi,
        tenviettat,
				canbo_chuc_danh,
				canbo_chuc_vu
    FROM datamart_hanoi.dm_user
    WHERE loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ tháng này (không lũy kế) ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_now
ON t_now.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t_now.monthkey = m.monthkey

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_prev

ON t_prev.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t_prev.monthkey < m.monthkey

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,
    u.canbo_id;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: SQL query execution failed. Incoming FlowFile will be penalized and routed to this relationship

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: Successfully created FlowFile from SQL query result set.

SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.loaicapcha,
    main.loaicap,
    main.iddv,
    main.donvi,
    main.tenviettat,
    main.canbo_id,
    main.canbo_hoten,
    main.account,
		main.canbo_chuc_danh,
		main.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    main.diem_danhgia,
    main.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    main.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    main.diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tongso,
    main.daht,
    main.daht_dh,
    main.daht_qh,
    main.daht_kh,

    main.dangth,
    main.dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qh,
    main.dangth_sqh,
    main.dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,
		
		main.tongso_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_dh_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_qh_thangtruoc,
		main.daht_kh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_th_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
		main.dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
		main.tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,


    main.diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03,
    main.diem_tc04,
    main.diem_tc05,
    main.diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia <  50 THEN 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
				ELSE 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia IS NULL THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 90 THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 70 THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia >= 50 THEN 'Loại C'
        WHEN main.diem_danhgia <  50 THEN 'Loại D'
				ELSE 'Chưa đánh giá'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(
SELECT
    base.monthkey,
    base.`year`,
    base.loaicapcha,
    base.loaicap,
    base.iddv,
    base.donvi,
    base.tenviettat,
    base.canbo_id,
    base.canbo_hoten,
    base.account,
		base.canbo_chuc_danh,
		base.canbo_chuc_vu,
		

    ( ( base.diem_tc01 + base.diem_tc02 + base.diem_tc03 ) / 3 ) AS diem_danhgia,
    base.diem_chinhtritutuong,
    base.diem_nanglucvakynang,
    base.diem_nhiemvu,

    base.tongso,
    base.daht,
    base.daht_dh,
    base.daht_qh,
    base.daht_kh,

    base.dangth,
    base.dangth_th,
    base.dangth_qh,
    base.dangth_sqh,
    base.dangth_kh,

    base.tyle_hoanthanh,
		
		base.tongso_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_dh_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_qh_thangtruoc,
		base.daht_kh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_th_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
		base.dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
		base.tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,


    base.diem_tc01,
    base.diem_tc02,
    base.diem_tc03,
    base.diem_tc04,
    base.diem_tc05,
    base.diem_tc06,

    NULL AS xeploai,
		NULL AS xeploai_loaidanhgia

FROM
(

SELECT
    m.monthkey,
    LEFT(m.monthkey,4) AS `year`,

    u.loaicapcha,
    u.loaicap,
    u.iddv,
    u.donvi,
    u.tenviettat,

    u.canbo_id,
    u.canbo_hoten,
    u.account,
		u.canbo_chuc_danh,
		u.canbo_chuc_vu,

    /* ===== điểm ===== */

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    20 AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    20 AS diem_nanglucvakynang,

    CASE
        WHEN SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) = 0 THEN 60
        ELSE ROUND(
            (SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
            NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100) * 0.6
        ,2)
    END AS diem_nhiemvu,

    /* ===== thống kê tháng này ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)) AS tongso,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) AS daht,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh,

    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth,0)) AS dangth,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh,
    SUM(IFNULL(t.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

    /* ===== thống kê tháng trước ===== */

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.tongso,0)) AS tongso_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0)) AS daht_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_dh,0)) AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_qh,0)) AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht_kh,0)) AS daht_kh_thangtruoc,

    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth,0)) AS dangth_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_th,0)) AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qh,0)) AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_sqh,0)) AS dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
    SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_kh,0)) AS dangth_kh_thangtruoc,

    ROUND(
        SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0)) /
        NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t_prev.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,

    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht,0))
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_tc01,
    100 AS diem_tc02,
    ROUND(
        (
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_dh,0)) +
            SUM(IFNULL(t.daht_qh,0))*0.75
        ) / NULLIF(SUM(IFNULL(t.tongso,0)),0) * 100
    ,2) AS diem_tc03,
    NULL AS diem_tc04,
    NULL AS diem_tc05,
    NULL AS diem_tc06

(
    /* ===== danh sách tháng ===== */
    SELECT DISTINCT monthkey
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    WHERE monthkey <= @monthkey
) m

CROSS JOIN

    SELECT

        canbo_hoten,
        account,
        loaicapcha,

    AND loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'
) u

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t

ON t.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND t.monthkey <= m.monthkey

LEFT JOIN
(
    /* ===== dữ liệu nhiệm vụ ===== */

    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID AS canbo_id,

        

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tongso,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_kh,

        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_kh


    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

    WHERE t.NguoiThucHienID IS NOT NULL
    AND t.loaicapcha = 'HĐND Thành phố'
    AND t.loaicap <> 'HĐND Xã, Phường'

    GROUP BY
        t.monthkey,
        t.NguoiThucHienID

) t_prev
ON t_prev.canbo_id = u.canbo_id
AND STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t_prev.monthkey, '01'), '%Y%m%d')
    = DATE_SUB(
        STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t.monthkey, '01'), '%Y%m%d'),
        INTERVAL 1 MONTH
      )

WHERE m.monthkey <= @monthkey

GROUP BY
    m.monthkey,

) base
) main

Database Connection Pooling Service.name: Database Connection Pooling Service
Database Connection Pooling Service.description: The Controller Service that is used to obtain connection to database

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles

SELECT	
    main.monthkey AS monthkey,
    LEFT(CAST(main.monthkey AS CHAR),4) AS `year`,
    main.don_vi_khoi AS loaicapcha,
    main.don_vi_cap AS loaicap,
    main.don_vi_id AS iddv,
    main.don_vi AS donvi,
    main.don_vi AS tenviettat,

    main.can_bo_id AS canbo_id,
    main.can_bo_ho_ten AS canbo_hoten,
    main.can_bo_account AS account,
    main.can_bo_chuc_danh AS can_bo_chuc_danh,
    main.can_bo_chuc_vu AS can_bo_chuc_vu,

    ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) AS diem_danhgia,

    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_chinhtritutuong,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nanglucvakynang,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_nhiemvu,

    main.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly AS tongso,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang AS den_han_trong_thang,
    main.daht AS daht,
    main.daht_dung_han AS daht_dh,
    main.daht_qua_han AS daht_qh,
    0 AS daht_kh,

    main.dangth AS dangth,
    main.dangth_trong_han AS dangth_th,
    main.dangth_qua_han AS dangth_qh,
    0 AS dangth_sqh,
    0 AS dangth_kh,

    main.tyle_hoanthanh,

    -- tháng trước
    main.tongso_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc AS ky_truoc_chuyen_sang_thangtruoc,
		main.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc AS den_han_trong_thang_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_thangtruoc AS daht_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_dh_thangtruoc AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
    main.daht_qh_thangtruoc AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS daht_kh_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_thangtruoc AS dangth_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_th_thangtruoc AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
    main.dangth_qh_thangtruoc AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_sqh_thangtruoc,
    0 AS dangth_kh_thangtruoc,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS tyle_hoanthanh_thangtruoc,

    main.diem_tc01 AS diem_tc01,
    main.diem_tc02 AS diem_tc02,
    main.diem_tc03 AS diem_tc03,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc04,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc05,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL(10,2))  AS diem_tc06,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa có nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Hoàn thành xuất sắc nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Hoàn thành tốt nhiệm vụ'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
        ELSE 'Không hoàn thành nhiệm vụ'
    END AS xeploai,

    CASE
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa đánh giá'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 90
            THEN 'Loại A'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 70
            THEN 'Loại B'
        WHEN ROUND((main.diem_tc01 + main.diem_tc02 + main.diem_tc03)/3,2) >= 50
            THEN 'Loại C'
        ELSE 'Loại D'
    END AS xeploai_loaidanhgia,

    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM (
    SELECT
        t.monthkey,
        t.don_vi_khoi,
        t.don_vi_cap,
        t.don_vi_id,
        t.don_vi,
        t.can_bo_id,
        t.can_bo_ho_ten,
        t.can_bo_account,
        t.can_bo_chuc_danh,
        t.can_bo_chuc_vu,

        t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,
        t.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,
        t.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,
        t.daht,
        t.daht_dung_han,
        t.daht_qua_han,
        t.dangth,
        t.dangth_trong_han,
        t.dangth_qua_han,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS tyle_hoanthanh,

        IFNULL(t_prev.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) AS tongso_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc,0) AS nhiem_vu_ton_chuyen_tu_ky_truoc_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thang,0) AS nhiem_vu_den_han_trong_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht,0) AS daht_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_dung_han,0) AS daht_dh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.daht_qua_han,0) AS daht_qh_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth,0) AS dangth_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_trong_han,0) AS dangth_th_thangtruoc,
        IFNULL(t_prev.dangth_qua_han,0) AS dangth_qh_thangtruoc,

				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc01,
				100 * IFNULL(t.daht / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly, 0), 0) AS diem_tc02,

        ROUND(
            (
                IFNULL(t.daht_dung_han,0)
                + IFNULL(t.daht_qua_han,0)*0.75
            ) / NULLIF(t.tong_nhiem_vu_can_xu_ly,0) * 100
        ,2) AS diem_tc03

FROM (
    SELECT *
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt a
    WHERE a.monthkey IN (
        DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m') + 0,
        DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y%m') + 0
    )
) t

    LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_kpi_theo_nguoi_xu_ly_new_rt t_prev
        ON t_prev.can_bo_id = t.can_bo_id
        AND t_prev.monthkey = DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(
                STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(t.monthkey,'01'),'%Y%m%d'),
                INTERVAL 1 MONTH
            ),
            '%Y%m'
        ) + 0
) main;

Database Connection Pooling Service.name: Database Connection Pooling Service
Database Connection Pooling Service.description: The Controller Service that is used to obtain connection to database

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: SQL query execution failed. Incoming FlowFile will be penalized and routed to this relationship

relationships.description: Successfully created FlowFile from SQL query result set.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query

If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query

It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_kiemdem_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_kiemdem_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_kiemdem_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_kiemdem_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.`date`,
    c.`month`,
		c.`year`,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
		c.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		c.loaicap_dvgiao,
		c.iddv_dvgiao,
		c.donvi_dvgiao,
		c.tenviettat_dvgiao,
		c.don_vi_cap_01_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
		c.loaicap_dvthuchien,
		c.iddv_dvthuchien,
		c.donvi_dvthuchien,
		c.tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		
		CASE 
			WHEN c.loaicap_dvthuchien IN ( 'Đảng bộ trực thuộc', 'Xã, Phường', 'HĐND Xã, Phường', 'MTTQ Xã, Phường' ) 
				AND ( c.donvi_dvthuchien LIKE '%xã%' OR c.donvi_dvthuchien LIKE '%phường%' )  THEN 'Xã, phường'
			WHEN donvi_dvthuchien IN ('HĐND Thành phố','Thành ủy Hà Nội', 'UBND Thành phố', 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội', 'Đảng bộ trực thuộc', 'Xã, Phường', 'HĐND Xã, Phường', 'MTTQ Xã, Phường' )
			OR loaicap_dvthuchien = 'Văn phòng UBND TP' THEN 'Chưa xác định'
			ELSE
				'Sở, ban, ngành'
		END AS donvi_filter,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_donvi_new_rt c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4

SQL select query.name: SQL select query

If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit

The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.`date` AS `date`,
		c.`month` AS `month`,
		c.`year` AS `year`,
    c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    'Đã giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_giaonv_new_rt c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

WHERE c.iddv IS NOT NULL AND don_vi_cap_01 = 'THÀNH PHỐ HÀ NỘI'
GROUP BY
    c.monthkey,
		LEFT(c.monthkey,4),
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
		c.loaicap,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu
    

ORDER BY 
    c.monthkey,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_new_rt__stg;

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query

It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

properties.SQL select query:
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_btctw;

INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_vanban_kiemdem_btctw
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.`date` AS `date`,
		c.`month` AS `month`,
		c.`year` AS `year`,
    c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL AND c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    'Đã giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_giaonv c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

WHERE c.iddv IS NOT NULL AND don_vi_cap_01 = 'BAN TỔ CHỨC TRUNG ƯƠNG'
GROUP BY
    c.monthkey,
		LEFT(c.monthkey,4),
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
		c.loaicap,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu
    

ORDER BY 
    c.monthkey,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu;

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_khoi_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_khoi_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_khoi_new_rt__stg;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_khoi_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    t.monthkey,
		t.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
    t.loaicapcha,
		t.loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,

    t.nhomvb_ma,
    t.nhomvb,

    NOW() AS syncdate

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.
