db-type.name: db-type
db-type.description: The type/flavor of database, used for generating database-specific code. In many cases the Generic type should suffice, but some databases (such as Oracle) require custom SQL clauses.

put-db-record-statement-type.name: put-db-record-statement-type
put-db-record-statement-type.description: Specifies the type of SQL Statement to generate. Please refer to the database documentation for a description of the behavior of each operation. Please note that some Database Types may not support certain Statement Types. If 'Use statement.type Attribute' is chosen, then the value is taken from the statement.type attribute in the FlowFile. The 'Use statement.type Attribute' option is the only one that allows the 'SQL' statement type. If 'SQL' is specified, the value of the field specified by the 'Field Containing SQL' property is expected to be a valid SQL statement on the target database, and will be executed as-is.

Statement Type Record Path.name: Statement Type Record Path
Statement Type Record Path.description: Specifies a RecordPath to evaluate against each Record in order to determine the Statement Type. The RecordPath should equate to either INSERT, UPDATE, UPSERT, or DELETE.

Data Record Path.name: Data Record Path
Data Record Path.description: If specified, this property denotes a RecordPath that will be evaluated against each incoming Record and the Record that results from evaluating the RecordPath will be sent to the database instead of sending the entire incoming Record. If not specified, the entire incoming Record will be published to the database.

put-db-record-dcbp-service.name: put-db-record-dcbp-service
put-db-record-dcbp-service.description: The Controller Service that is used to obtain a connection to the database for sending records.

put-db-record-catalog-name.name: put-db-record-catalog-name
put-db-record-catalog-name.description: The name of the catalog that the statement should update. This may not apply for the database that you are updating. In this case, leave the field empty. Note that if the property is set and the database is case-sensitive, the catalog name must match the database's catalog name exactly.

put-db-record-schema-name.name: put-db-record-schema-name
put-db-record-schema-name.description: The name of the schema that the table belongs to. This may not apply for the database that you are updating. In this case, leave the field empty. Note that if the property is set and the database is case-sensitive, the schema name must match the database's schema name exactly.

put-db-record-table-name.name: put-db-record-table-name
put-db-record-table-name.description: The name of the table that the statement should affect. Note that if the database is case-sensitive, the table name must match the database's table name exactly.

put-db-record-binary-format.name: put-db-record-binary-format
put-db-record-binary-format.description: The format to be applied when decoding string values to binary.

allowableValue.description: String values for binary columns contain the original value as text via UTF-8 character encoding

String values for binary columns contain the original value in Base64 encoded format

put-db-record-translate-field-names.name: put-db-record-translate-field-names
put-db-record-translate-field-names.description: If true, the Processor will attempt to translate field names into the appropriate column names for the table specified. If false, the field names must match the column names exactly, or the column will not be updated

put-db-record-unmatched-field-behavior.name: put-db-record-unmatched-field-behavior
put-db-record-unmatched-field-behavior.description: If an incoming record has a field that does not map to any of the database table's columns, this property specifies how to handle the situation

put-db-record-unmatched-column-behavior.name: put-db-record-unmatched-column-behavior
put-db-record-unmatched-column-behavior.description: If an incoming record does not have a field mapping for all of the database table's columns, this property specifies how to handle the situation

allowableValue.description: Any column in the database that does not have a field in the document will be assumed to not be required.  No notification will be logged

A flow will fail if any column in the database that does not have a field in the document.  An error will be logged

put-db-record-update-keys.name: put-db-record-update-keys
put-db-record-update-keys.description: A comma-separated list of column names that uniquely identifies a row in the database for UPDATE statements. If the Statement Type is UPDATE and this property is not set, the table's Primary Keys are used. In this case, if no Primary Key exists, the conversion to SQL will fail if Unmatched Column Behaviour is set to FAIL. This property is ignored if the Statement Type is INSERT

put-db-record-field-containing-sql.name: put-db-record-field-containing-sql
put-db-record-field-containing-sql.description: If the Statement Type is 'SQL' (as set in the statement.type attribute), this field indicates which field in the record(s) contains the SQL statement to execute. The value of the field must be a single SQL statement. If the Statement Type is not 'SQL', this field is ignored.

put-db-record-allow-multiple-statements.name: put-db-record-allow-multiple-statements
put-db-record-allow-multiple-statements.description: If the Statement Type is 'SQL' (as set in the statement.type attribute), this field indicates whether to split the field value by a semicolon and execute each statement separately. If any statement causes an error, the entire set of statements will be rolled back. If the Statement Type is not 'SQL', this field is ignored.

put-db-record-quoted-identifiers.name: put-db-record-quoted-identifiers
put-db-record-quoted-identifiers.description: Enabling this option will cause all column names to be quoted, allowing you to use reserved words as column names in your tables.

put-db-record-quoted-table-identifiers.name: put-db-record-quoted-table-identifiers
put-db-record-quoted-table-identifiers.description: Enabling this option will cause the table name to be quoted to support the use of special characters in the table name.

put-db-record-query-timeout.name: put-db-record-query-timeout
put-db-record-query-timeout.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL statement , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

table-schema-cache-size.name: table-schema-cache-size

put-db-record-max-batch-size.name: put-db-record-max-batch-size
put-db-record-max-batch-size.description: Specifies maximum number of sql statements to be included in each batch sent to the database. Zero means the batch size is not limited, and all statements are put into a single batch which can cause high memory usage issues for a very large number of statements.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively). If set to true, the driver/database automatically handles the commit/rollback. Setting this property to 'No value' will leave the database connection's autocommit mode unmodified.

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    t.`date`,
		t.monthkey AS `month`,
		t.`year`,
    t.loaicapcha,
		t.loaicap,
		t.iddv,
		t.iddv_ext,
		t.donvi,
		t.tenviettat,
		t.iddv_captren,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_dh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'  AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    /* ===== CHƯA HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_qh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_sqh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành'  AND t.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_kh,

    NOW() AS syncdate

FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt t
GROUP BY
    t.`date`,
		t.monthkey,
		t.`year`,
    t.loaicapcha,
		t.loaicap,
		t.iddv,
		t.iddv_ext,
		t.donvi,
		t.tenviettat;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_dieuhanh_lanhdao_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__stg
SELECT
    c.monthkey,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,

    /* ÉP loaicap = DepartmentName có Level = 3 */
    CASE
        WHEN c.iddv IS NULL
            THEN 'Chưa xác định'
        WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
        WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
        WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
        WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
        ELSE NULL
    END AS loaicap,

    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		d1.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,

    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS daht,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_dh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS daht_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN 1 END) AS daht_kh,

    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' THEN 1 END) AS dangth,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_th,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_qh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_sqh,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN c.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN 1 END) AS dangth_kh,
		SUM(c.tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
		SUM(c.tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,

    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
    NOW() AS syncdate
FROM ( SELECT * FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_donvi_new_rt
			WHERE donvi_dvthuchien NOT IN ('Sở ngành', 'Xã, Phường') ) c

/* Level hiện tại */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d1
    ON c.iddv = d1.DepartmentId

/* Cha */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d2
    ON d2.DepartmentId = d1.ParentId

/* Ông */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d3
    ON d3.DepartmentId = d2.ParentId

/* Cụ */
LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d4
    ON d4.DepartmentId = d3.ParentId

GROUP BY
    c.monthkey,
		c.Ma,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.iddv,
    c.donvi,
    c.tenviettat,
		d1.ParentId,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		c.NgayVanBan,
    c.LinhVuc,
    c.Kieu,
		c.UuTien,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.nhomvb,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
    loaicap

ORDER BY 
    c.monthkey,
		c.don_vi_cap_01,
    c.loaicapcha,
    c.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    c.nhomvb_ma,
    c.NhomGiaoNhan,
		c.NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tongquan_donvi_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

SELECT
    t.monthkey,
    t.loaicapcha,
    t.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		t.NgayVanBan,
    t.LinhVuc,
    t.Kieu,
		t.UuTien,

    /* Tổng số nhiệm vụ */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* ===== ĐÃ HOÀN THÀNH ===== */
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Đã hoàn thành%'

        CASE

            THEN 1 ELSE 0

        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_qh,

        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành không hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS daht_kh,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai LIKE 'Chưa hoàn thành%' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END

        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS dangth_th,

    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN t.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0

        CASE

		'Được giao' AS NhomGiaoNhan,
		MAX( t.syncdate)

GROUP BY 
 t.monthkey,

 t.nhom_nhiem_vu

		NhomPhamViNhiemVu
;

This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
main.loaicap AS loaicap,
main.iddv AS iddv,
main.donvi AS donvi,
main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
main.Kieu AS Kieu,
main.tongso AS tongso,
main.daht AS daht,
main.daht_dh AS daht_dh,
main.daht_qh AS daht_qh,
main.daht_kh AS daht_kh,
main.dangth AS dangth,
main.dangth_th AS dangth_th,
main.dangth_qh AS dangth_qh,
main.dangth_sqh AS dangth_sqh,
main.dangth_kh AS dangth_kh,
main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
main.syncdate AS syncdate

FROM (
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
		CASE
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		NULL AS loaicap_dvgiao,
    dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvgiao,
    IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvgiao,
    
		IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
		
		CASE
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha,
		NULL AS loaicap,
    d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
    IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
    
		IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
		CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
				WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
		CASE
        WHEN r.Type = 1 THEN 'Chỉ thị'
        WHEN r.Type = 2 THEN 'Nghị quyết'
				WHEN r.Type = 3 THEN 'Công văn'
				WHEN r.Type = 4 THEN 'Kết luận'
				WHEN r.Type = 5 THEN 'Thông báo'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS Kieu,

    /* Tổng số */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* Nhóm đã hoàn thành (Status = 4) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  <= t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  > t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
		NULL as daht_kh,
    /* Nhóm đang thực hiện (Status in -1,0,1,2,3) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
		NULL AS dangth_kh,
		
		COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId,rg3.ResolutionGroupId,rg2.ResolutionGroupId,rg1.ResolutionGroupId,rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
		COALESCE(rg4.Name,rg3.Name,rg2.Name,rg1.Name,rg.Name)  AS nhomvb,
		NOW() AS syncdate

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId -- mức 1: cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE
    t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m'),
		t.AssignDepartment,
    t.TargetDepartment,
		t.DocCode
		) main
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    iddv;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_tiepnhan_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

Database Connection Pooling Service.name: Database Connection Pooling Service
Database Connection Pooling Service.description: The Controller Service that is used to obtain connection to database

sql-pre-query.name: sql-pre-query
sql-pre-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed before the main SQL query is executed. For example, set session properties before main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

SQL select query.name: SQL select query
SQL select query.description: The SQL select query to execute. The query can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming flowfiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming flow file is expected to contain a valid SQL select query, to be issued by the processor to the database. Note that Expression Language is not evaluated for flow file contents.

sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query
sql-post-query.description: A semicolon-delimited list of queries executed after the main SQL query is executed. Example like setting session properties after main query. It's possible to include semicolons in the statements themselves by escaping them with a backslash ('\;'). Results/outputs from these queries will be suppressed if there are no errors.

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile that is generated will be unique. If false, a random value will be generated and all FlowFiles will get the same content but this offers much higher throughput

generate-ff-custom-text.name: generate-ff-custom-text
generate-ff-custom-text.description: If Data Format is text and if Unique FlowFiles is false, then this custom text will be used as content of the generated FlowFiles and the File Size will be ignored. Finally, if Expression Language is used, evaluation will be performed only once per batch of generated FlowFiles

character-set.name: character-set
character-set.description: Specifies the character set to use when writing the bytes of Custom Text to a flow file.

mime-type.name: mime-type
mime-type.description: Specifies the value to set for the "mime.type" attribute.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

properties.putsql-sql-statement:
/* [RT 12/11] upsert + delete theo syncdate (sync_ts của NiFi) — bảng không bao giờ rỗng */
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt 

SELECT
		main.monthkey AS monthkey,
		main.`date` AS `date`,
		main.`month` AS `month`,
		main.`year` AS `year`,
		main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
		main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
		main.NhomNhiemVu AS NhomNhiemVu,
		main.ma_nv_cha AS ma_nv_cha,
		main.`Code` AS `Code`,		
		CONCAT(LEFT(main.monthkey,4),'-',main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,'-',main.Ma) AS idnv,
		CONCAT(LEFT(main.monthkey,4),'-',main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,'-',LEFT(MD5(main.TenNhiemVu), 12)) AS tennv_viettat,
		main.Ma AS Ma,
		main.TenNhiemVu AS TenNhiemVu,
		main.SanPhamChuYeu AS SanPhamChuYeu,
		main.ThoiHanHoanThanh AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
		main.NgayHoanThanh AS NgayHoanThanh,
		main.TinhTrang AS TinhTrang,
		main.nhiem_vu_cho_duyet AS nhiem_vu_cho_duyet,
		main.TienDoHoanThanh AS TienDoHoanThanh,
		main.songayquahan AS songayquahan,
		main.tongtg_canxuly AS tongtg_canxuly,
		main.tongtg_daxuly AS tongtg_daxuly,
		main.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
		main.loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		main.loaicap_dvgiao AS loaicap_dvgiao,
		main.iddv_dvgiao AS iddv_dvgiao,
		main.donvi_dvgiao AS donvi_dvgiao,
		main.tenviettat_dvgiao AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
		main.iddv_captren_dvgiao AS iddv_captren_dvgiao,
		main.NguoiGiaoNhiemVuID AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVuID,
		main.NguoiGiaoNhiemVu AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
		main.don_vi_cap_01 AS don_vi_cap_01,
		main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
		main.loaicap AS loaicap,
		main.iddv AS iddv,
		main.donvi AS donvi,
		main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
		main.iddv_captren AS iddv_captren,
		main.NguoiThucHienID AS NguoiThucHienID,
		main.NguoiThucHien AS NguoiThucHien,
		main.DonViPhoiHop AS DonViPhoiHop,
		main.iddv_dvchutri AS iddv_dvchutri,
		main.DonViChuTri AS DonViChuTri,
		main.don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv AS don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv,
		main.loaicapcha_dvtaonv AS loaicapcha_dvtaonv,
		main.loaicap_dvtaonv AS loaicap_dvtaonv,
		main.iddv_dvtaonv AS iddv_dvtaonv,
		main.donvi_dvtaonv AS donvi_dvtaonv,
		main.tenviettat_dvtaonv AS tenviettat_dvtaonv,
		main.iddv_captren_dvtaonv AS iddv_captren_dvtaonv,
		main.NguoiTaoNhiemVuID AS NguoiTaoNhiemVuID,
		main.NguoiTaoNhiemVu AS NguoiTaoNhiemVu,
		main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		main.NgayVanBan AS NgayVanBan,
		main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
		main.Kieu AS Kieu,
		main.UuTien AS UuTien,
		main.KetQuaGhiChu AS KetQuaGhiChu,
		CASE  
        WHEN main.loaicapcha = main.loaicapcha_dvgiao THEN
                'Nhiệm vụ nội bộ'
        ELSE
                'Nhiệm vụ ngoài khối'
    END AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
		NULL AS NhomCauTrucNhiemVu,
		CASE
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' đúng hạn')
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' trong hạn')
				ELSE
					main.TrangThai
		END AS TrangThai,
    CASE
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 'HT đúng hạn'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 'HT quá hạn'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT quá hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'THEN 'Chưa HT sắp quá hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN 'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END AS TrangThaiVietTat,
		CASE
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn' THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'
        WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT quá hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai = 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn' THEN 'Chưa HT sắp quá hạn'
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
				WHEN main.TrangThai IN ( 'Không xác định', 'Chưa xác định') AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'
        ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
    END AS TrangThaiVietTat2,
		NULL AS TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
		'${sync_ts}' AS syncdate
FROM (
    SELECT
        /* 01 - monthkey: lấy theo ExpireDate dạng YYYYMM */
        DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
        DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m%d') + 0 AS `date`,
				DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%m/%Y') AS `month`,
        DATE_FORMAT( COALESCE( t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate, t.CreatedDate), '%Y') + 0 AS `year`,
        /* 04 - Group + VB */
        /* COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId, rg3.ResolutionGroupId, rg2.ResolutionGroupId, rg1.ResolutionGroupId, rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
				CASE 
						WHEN COALESCE(rg4.`Name`, rg3.`Name`, rg2.`Name`, rg1.`Name`, rg.`Name`) = 'Văn bản chỉ đạo theo NQ 57' THEN 'Nghị quyết 57'
						ELSE COALESCE(rg4.`Name`, rg3.`Name`, rg2.`Name`, rg1.`Name`, rg.`Name`)
				END AS nhomvb, */
        rg.ResolutionGroupId AS nhomvb_ma,
				CASE 
						WHEN rg.`Name` = 'Văn bản chỉ đạo theo NQ 57' THEN 'Nghị quyết 57'
						ELSE  rg.`Name`
				END AS nhomvb,
				t.NameGroup AS NhomNhiemVu,
        r.DocCode AS ma_vb,
        r.Compendium AS vb,
				
        /* 05 - Mã nhiệm vụ */
				t.`Code` AS `Code`,
        t.TaskId AS Ma,
				t.ParentId AS ma_nv_cha,


        /* 06 - Tên nhiệm vụ */
        CASE 
						WHEN t.Title LIKE '%<script>%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.Title, '<script>', 1))
						ELSE t.Title
				END AS TenNhiemVu,
        NULL AS SanPhamChuYeu,

        /* 07 - Thời hạn hoàn thành */
        t.ExpireDate AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
				COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ApprovedDate) AS NgayHoanThanh,

        /* 08 - Tình trạng */
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành'
        END AS TinhTrang,
				nvcd.nhiem_vu_cho_duyet AS nhiem_vu_cho_duyet,

        /* 09 - Tiến độ hoàn thành */
        CONCAT(t.Progress, '%') AS TienDoHoanThanh,

        /* 10 - Số ngày quá hạn */
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Status NOT IN (3,4) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() 
                THEN DATEDIFF(NOW(), t.ExpireDate)
            WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND t.CompletedDate > t.ExpireDate
                THEN DATEDIFF(t.CompletedDate, t.ExpireDate)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS songayquahan,

        /* 11 - Đơn vị */
				CAST(
				CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 1 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
				CAST(
				CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 2 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
				CAST(
				CASE
						WHEN t.AssignDepartment IS NULL OR t.AssignDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  dv_giao.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao1.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao1.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao2.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao2.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao3.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao3.DepartmentName
						WHEN dv_giao4.Level = 3 THEN dv_giao4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS CHAR(255)) AS loaicap_dvgiao,
				dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvgiao,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName, 'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvgiao,
				IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName, 'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
				dv_giao.ParentId AS iddv_captren_dvgiao,
				t.AssignUser AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_giao.FullName, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 1 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 1 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 1 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 1 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 1 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS don_vi_cap_01,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 2 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 2 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 2 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 2 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 2 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicapcha,
				CASE
						WHEN t.TargetDepartment IS NULL OR t.TargetDepartment = 'Chưa xác định'
								THEN 'Chưa xác định'
						WHEN  d.Level = 3 THEN d.DepartmentName
						WHEN d1.Level = 3 THEN d1.DepartmentName
						WHEN d2.Level = 3 THEN d2.DepartmentName
						WHEN d3.Level = 3 THEN d3.DepartmentName
						WHEN d4.Level = 3 THEN d4.DepartmentName
						ELSE NULL
				END AS loaicap,
				d.DepartmentId AS iddv,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
				IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
				d.ParentId AS iddv_captren,
				t.TargetUser AS NguoiThucHienID,
				IFNULL(u_thuchien.FullName, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiThucHien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				NULL AS iddv_dvchutri,
				NULL AS DonViChuTri,
				/* Bên tạo nhiệm vụ */
				IFNULL(u_taonv.don_vi_cap_01, 'Chưa xác định') AS don_vi_cap_01_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicapcha, 'Chưa xác định') AS loaicapcha_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.loaicap, 'Chưa xác định') AS loaicap_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv AS iddv_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.donvi, 'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvtaonv,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.tenviettat, 'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvtaonv,
				u_taonv.iddv_captren AS iddv_captren_dvtaonv,
				t.CreateUser AS NguoiTaoNhiemVuID,
				IFNULL(u_taonv.canbo_hoten, 'Chưa xác định') AS NguoiTaoNhiemVu,

        /* 12 - Văn bản giao */
        CASE
            WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode ,"Số ", "")
						WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
            ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
        END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
				r.StartDate AS NgayVanBan,
				IFNULL(s.SectorName, 'Chưa xác định') AS LinhVuc,

        /* 13 - Ghi chú */
        NULL AS KetQuaGhiChu,

        /* 14 - Trạng thái chi tiết */
        CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE( COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  <= DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND DATE(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate) )  > DATE(t.ExpireDate)
								THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE( NOW() ) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW() ) > 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) < DATE( NOW() )
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
						WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND DATE(t.ExpireDate) >= DATE( NOW() ) AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW() ) <= 5 
								THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS TrangThai,
				
				CASE
						WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN
								DATEDIFF(
										COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate),
										t.CreatedDate
								)
						ELSE NULL
				END AS tongtg_daxuly,
				DATEDIFF(
						t.ExpireDate,
						t.CreatedDate
				) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				CASE
						WHEN r.Type = 1  THEN 'Chỉ thị'
						WHEN r.Type = 2  THEN 'Nghị quyết'
						WHEN r.Type = 3  THEN 'Công văn'
						WHEN r.Type = 4  THEN 'Kết luận'
						WHEN r.Type = 5  THEN 'Thông báo'
						WHEN r.Type = 6  THEN 'Đề nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 7  THEN 'Quyết định'
						WHEN r.Type = 8  THEN 'Báo cáo'
						WHEN r.Type = 9  THEN 'Quy định'
						WHEN r.Type = 10 THEN 'Hợp đồng'
						WHEN r.Type = 11 THEN 'Đăng ký'
						WHEN r.Type = 12 THEN 'Biên bản'
						WHEN r.Type = 13 THEN 'Quy trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 14 THEN 'Hướng dẫn'
						WHEN r.Type = 15 THEN 'Kiến nghị'
						WHEN r.Type = 16 THEN 'Thanh tra'
						WHEN r.Type = 17 THEN 'Tờ trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 18 THEN 'Giấy phép'
						WHEN r.Type = 19 THEN 'Giấy mời'
						WHEN r.Type = 20 THEN 'Danh sách'
						WHEN r.Type = 21 THEN 'Kế hoạch'
						WHEN r.Type = 22 THEN 'Chương trình'
						WHEN r.Type = 23 THEN 'Giấy uỷ quyền'
						WHEN r.Type = 24 THEN 'Đề án'
						WHEN r.Type = 25 THEN 'Thông tư'
						WHEN r.Type = 26 THEN 'Quy chế'
						ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
				END AS Kieu,
				CASE
            WHEN t.Priority = 3 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
            WHEN t.Priority = 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN t.Priority = 1 THEN 'Khẩn'
            ELSE 'Thường'
        END AS UuTien

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

JDBC Connection Pool.name: JDBC Connection Pool
JDBC Connection Pool.description: Specifies the JDBC Connection Pool to use in order to convert the JSON message to a SQL statement. The Connection Pool is necessary in order to determine the appropriate database column types.

putsql-sql-statement.name: putsql-sql-statement
putsql-sql-statement.description: The SQL statement to execute. The statement can be empty, a constant value, or built from attributes using Expression Language. If this property is specified, it will be used regardless of the content of incoming FlowFiles. If this property is empty, the content of the incoming FlowFile is expected to contain a valid SQL statement, to be issued by the processor to the database.

Support Fragmented Transactions.name: Support Fragmented Transactions
Support Fragmented Transactions.description: If true, when a FlowFile is consumed by this Processor, the Processor will first check the fragment.identifier and fragment.count attributes of that FlowFile. If the fragment.count value is greater than 1, the Processor will not process any FlowFile with that fragment.identifier until all are available; at that point, it will process all FlowFiles with that fragment.identifier as a single transaction, in the order specified by the FlowFiles' fragment.index attributes. This Provides atomicity of those SQL statements. Once any statement of this transaction throws exception when executing, this transaction will be rolled back. When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. If this value is false, these attributes will be ignored and the updates will occur independent of one another.

database-session-autocommit.name: database-session-autocommit
database-session-autocommit.description: The autocommit mode to set on the database connection being used. If set to false, the operation(s) will be explicitly committed or rolled back (based on success or failure respectively), if set to true the driver/database handles the commit/rollback.

Transaction Timeout.name: Transaction Timeout
Transaction Timeout.description: If the <Support Fragmented Transactions> property is set to true, specifies how long to wait for all FlowFiles for a particular fragment.identifier attribute to arrive before just transferring all of the FlowFiles with that identifier to the 'failure' relationship

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The preferred number of FlowFiles to put to the database in a single transaction

Obtain Generated Keys.name: Obtain Generated Keys
Obtain Generated Keys.description: If true, any key that is automatically generated by the database will be added to the FlowFile that generated it using the sql.generate.key attribute. This may result in slightly slower performance and is not supported by all databases.

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure
rollback-on-failure.description: Specify how to handle error. By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. Instead, you may want to rollback currently processed FlowFiles and stop further processing immediately. In that case, you can do so by enabling this 'Rollback On Failure' property.  If enabled, failed FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship without penalizing it and being processed repeatedly until it gets processed successfully or removed by other means. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated

UPDATE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan t

LEFT JOIN (
    -- Danh sách nhiệm vụ có con
    SELECT DISTINCT ma_nv_cha
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    WHERE ma_nv_cha IS NOT NULL
) c ON c.ma_nv_cha = t.Ma

LEFT JOIN (
    -- Đếm số bản ghi theo tennv_viettat
    SELECT tennv_viettat, COUNT(*) cnt
    FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan
    GROUP BY tennv_viettat
) g ON g.tennv_viettat = t.tennv_viettat

SET t.NhomCauTrucNhiemVu =
CASE
    WHEN t.ma_nv_cha IS NOT NULL 
         OR c.ma_nv_cha IS NOT NULL
        THEN 'Nhiệm vụ theo chuỗi'

    WHEN g.cnt = 1
        THEN 'Nhiệm vụ đơn lẻ'

    ELSE 'Chưa xác định'
END;

rollback-on-failure.name: rollback-on-failure

By default (false), if an error occurs while processing a FlowFile, the FlowFile will be routed to 'failure' or 'retry' relationship based on error type, and processor can continue with next FlowFile. It is important to set adequate 'Yield Duration' to avoid retrying too frequently.

/* [RT 12/11] upsert + delete theo syncdate (sync_ts của NiFi) — bảng không bao giờ rỗng */
SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 10000;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_tiepnhan_new_rt (`monthkey`, `date`, `month`, `year`, `nhomvb_ma`, `nhomvb`, `ma_nv_cha`, `Code`, `idnv`, `tennv_viettat`, `Ma`, `TenNhiemVu`, `SanPhamChuYeu`, `ThoiHanHoanThanh`, `NgayHoanThanh`, `TinhTrang`, `TienDoHoanThanh`, `songayquahan`, `tongtg_canxuly`, `tongtg_daxuly`, `don_vi_cap_01`, `loaicapcha`, `loaicap`, `don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao`, `loaicapcha_dvgiao`, `iddv_dvgiao`, `donvi_dvgiao`, `tenviettat_dvgiao`, `NguoiGiaoNhiemVu`, `donvi_dvthuchien`, `DonViPhoiHop`, `iddv_dvchutri`, `DonViChuTri`, `VanBanGiaoNhiemVu`, `NgayVanBan`, `LinhVuc`, `Kieu`, `UuTien`, `KetQuaGhiChu`, `NhomPhamViNhiemVu`, `TrangThai`, `TrangThaiVietTat`, `TrangThaiVietTat2`, `TenNhiemVu_Mobile`, `syncdate`)
SELECT
    main.monthkey,
    main.`date`,
    main.monthkey,
    main.`year`,
    main.nhomvb_ma,
    main.nhomvb,
    main.ma_nv_cha,
	main.`Code`,
	main.idnv,
	main.tennv_viettat,
    main.Ma,
    main.TenNhiemVu,
    main.SanPhamChuYeu,
    main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
    main.NgayHoanThanh,

    /* các cột còn lại */
    main.TinhTrang,
    main.TienDoHoanThanh,
    CASE
        /* chưa hoàn thành nhưng đã quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh < CURDATE()
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      CURDATE(),
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        /* đã hoàn thành nhưng quá hạn */
        WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
             AND main.NgayHoanThanh > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
        THEN DATEDIFF(
                      main.NgayHoanThanh,
                      main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
                         )

        ELSE NULL
    END AS songayquahan,
	main.tongtg_canxuly AS tongtg_canxuly,
	main.tongtg_daxuly AS tongtg_daxuly,
    -- main.songayquahan,
    main.don_vi_cap_01,
    main.loaicapcha,
	main.loaicap,
    main.don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
    main.loaicapcha_dvgiao,
    main.iddv_dvgiao,
    main.donvi_dvgiao,
    main.tenviettat_dvgiao,
    main.NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.donvi_dvthuchien,
    main.DonViPhoiHop,
	main.iddv_dvchutri,
	main.DonViChuTri,
    main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
    main.NgayVanBan,
	main.LinhVuc,
    main.Kieu,
	main.UuTien,
    main.KetQuaGhiChu,
	main.NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
                /* TRẠNG THÁI SUY RA */
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Đã hoàn thành quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						 AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa hoàn thành quá hạn'
				-- NVU không hạn
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' đúng hạn')
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					CONCAT(main.TinhTrang,' trong hạn')
		END AS TrangThai,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'CHT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'CHT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'CHT quá hạn'
				
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'CHT trong hạn'
		END AS  TrangThaiVietTat,
		CASE
				-- 1. Đã hoàn thành đúng hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT đúng hạn'

				-- 2. Đã hoàn thành quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NOT NULL
						AND main.NgayHoanThanh
								 > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'HT quá hạn'

				-- 3. Chưa hoàn thành – trong hạn (còn > 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) > 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT trong hạn'

				-- 4. Chưa hoàn thành – sắp quá hạn (còn 1 ngày)
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() <= main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						AND DATEDIFF(
										main.ThoiHanHoanThanh,
										CURDATE()
								 ) <= 5
						THEN 'Chưa HT sắp quá hạn'

				-- 5. Chưa hoàn thành – quá hạn
				WHEN main.NgayHoanThanh IS NULL
						AND CURDATE() > main.ThoiHanHoanThanh
						THEN 'Chưa HT quá hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành' THEN
					'HT đúng hạn'
				WHEN main.ThoiHanHoanThanh IS NULL AND main.TinhTrang = 'Chưa hoàn thành' THEN
					'Chưa HT trong hạn'
		END AS TrangThaiVietTat2,
                main.TenNhiemVu_Mobile,
    '${sync_ts}' AS syncdate

FROM (
    -- subquery của Tùng giữ nguyên
SELECT
        MAX(monthkey) AS monthkey,
				MAX(`date`) AS `date`,
        MAX(`month`) AS `month`,
				MAX(`year`) AS `year`,
        nhomvb_ma,
        MAX(nhomvb) AS nhomvb,
        MAX(ma_nv_cha) AS ma_nv_cha,
        -- SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT LEFT(Ma,50) ORDER BY Ma SEPARATOR ', '),1,255) AS Ma,
				MIN(`Code`) AS `Code`,
				MIN(idnv) AS idnv,
				MIN(tennv_viettat) AS tennv_viettat,
				MIN(Ma) AS Ma,
        TenNhiemVu,
        MAX(SanPhamChuYeu) AS SanPhamChuYeu,
        MAX(ThoiHanHoanThanh) AS ThoiHanHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND 
						COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN MAX(
            CASE
                WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                THEN NgayHoanThanh
            END
						)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS NgayHoanThanh,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT( iddv) > 0 AND COUNT( iddv)
                 = COUNT( CASE
                        WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                        THEN 1
                   END)
            THEN 'Đã hoàn thành'
            ELSE 'Chưa hoàn thành'
        END AS TinhTrang,
        CONCAT(ROUND(
               COUNT( CASE
                               WHEN TinhTrang = 'Đã hoàn thành'
                               THEN iddv
               END)
               * 100.0
               / NULLIF(COUNT( iddv), 0),
               0
            ),'%') AS TienDoHoanThanh,
        MAX(songayquahan) AS songayquahan,
				MAX(tongtg_canxuly) AS tongtg_canxuly,
				MAX(tongtg_daxuly) AS tongtg_daxuly,
        don_vi_cap_01 AS don_vi_cap_01,
        loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
        don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao AS don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
        loaicapcha_dvgiao AS loaicapcha_dvgiao,
        MAX(iddv_dvgiao) AS iddv_dvgiao,
        MAX(donvi_dvgiao) AS donvi_dvgiao,
        NULL AS tenviettat_dvgiao, -- MAX(tenviettat_dvgiao) AS tenviettat_dvgiao,
        SUBSTRING(GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            ORDER BY NguoiGiaoNhiemVu
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ),1,255) AS NguoiGiaoNhiemVu,
				loaicap,
        GROUP_CONCAT(
            DISTINCT donvi
            ORDER BY donvi
            SEPARATOR '; '
        ) AS donvi_dvthuchien,
        NULL AS DonViPhoiHop,
				MAX(iddv_dvchutri) AS iddv_dvchutri,
				MAX(DonViChuTri ) AS DonViChuTri,
        MAX(VanBanGiaoNhiemVu) AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        MAX(NgayVanBan) AS NgayVanBan,
				IFNULL(MAX(LinhVuc),'Chưa xác định') AS LinhVuc,
        MAX(Kieu) AS Kieu,
				CASE MIN(
						CASE UuTien
								WHEN 'Hỏa tốc'      THEN 1
								WHEN 'Thượng khẩn'  THEN 2
								WHEN 'Khẩn'         THEN 3
								WHEN 'Thường'       THEN 4
								ELSE 5
						END
				)
						WHEN 1 THEN 'Hỏa tốc'
						WHEN 2 THEN 'Thượng khẩn'
						WHEN 3 THEN 'Khẩn'
						WHEN 4 THEN 'Thường'
						ELSE 'Không xác định'
				END AS UuTien,
        MAX(KetQuaGhiChu) AS KetQuaGhiChu,
				MAX(NhomPhamViNhiemVu) AS NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
				NULL AS TenNhiemVu_Mobile
    FROM qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_tiepnhan_new_rt
		-- WHERE loaicapcha !='Thành ủy Hà Nội'
		-- AND iddv_dvgiao NOT IN (1307)
		-- AND iddv IN (698, 1775, 1790)
		-- OR loaicap IN ('Sở ngành','Xã, Phường')
    GROUP BY
				monthkey,
				TenNhiemVu,
				don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
				loaicapcha_dvgiao,
				don_vi_cap_01,
				loaicap,
				loaicapcha,
				`month`,
				nhomvb_ma,
				VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        NhomPhamViNhiemVu,
        TenNhiemVu
) main
ORDER BY
		`year`,
		monthkey,
		`date`,
        TenNhiemVu,
		don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao,
        loaicapcha_dvgiao,
		don_vi_cap_01,
        loaicapcha,
        `month`,
        nhomvb_ma,
        VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
        TenNhiemVu
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
    `monthkey` = VALUES(`monthkey`),
    `date` = VALUES(`date`),
    `month` = VALUES(`month`),
    `year` = VALUES(`year`),
    `nhomvb_ma` = VALUES(`nhomvb_ma`),
    `nhomvb` = VALUES(`nhomvb`),
    `ma_nv_cha` = VALUES(`ma_nv_cha`),
    `Code` = VALUES(`Code`),
    `idnv` = VALUES(`idnv`),
    `tennv_viettat` = VALUES(`tennv_viettat`),
    `TenNhiemVu` = VALUES(`TenNhiemVu`),
    `SanPhamChuYeu` = VALUES(`SanPhamChuYeu`),
    `ThoiHanHoanThanh` = VALUES(`ThoiHanHoanThanh`),
    `NgayHoanThanh` = VALUES(`NgayHoanThanh`),
    `TinhTrang` = VALUES(`TinhTrang`),
    `TienDoHoanThanh` = VALUES(`TienDoHoanThanh`),
    `songayquahan` = VALUES(`songayquahan`),
    `tongtg_canxuly` = VALUES(`tongtg_canxuly`),
    `tongtg_daxuly` = VALUES(`tongtg_daxuly`),
    `don_vi_cap_01` = VALUES(`don_vi_cap_01`),
    `loaicapcha` = VALUES(`loaicapcha`),
    `loaicap` = VALUES(`loaicap`),
    `don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao` = VALUES(`don_vi_cap_01_dvgiao`),
    `loaicapcha_dvgiao` = VALUES(`loaicapcha_dvgiao`),
    `iddv_dvgiao` = VALUES(`iddv_dvgiao`),
    `donvi_dvgiao` = VALUES(`donvi_dvgiao`),
    `tenviettat_dvgiao` = VALUES(`tenviettat_dvgiao`),
    `NguoiGiaoNhiemVu` = VALUES(`NguoiGiaoNhiemVu`),
    `donvi_dvthuchien` = VALUES(`donvi_dvthuchien`),
    `DonViPhoiHop` = VALUES(`DonViPhoiHop`),
    `iddv_dvchutri` = VALUES(`iddv_dvchutri`),
    `DonViChuTri` = VALUES(`DonViChuTri`),
    `VanBanGiaoNhiemVu` = VALUES(`VanBanGiaoNhiemVu`),
    `NgayVanBan` = VALUES(`NgayVanBan`),
    `LinhVuc` = VALUES(`LinhVuc`),
    `Kieu` = VALUES(`Kieu`),
    `UuTien` = VALUES(`UuTien`),
    `KetQuaGhiChu` = VALUES(`KetQuaGhiChu`),
    `NhomPhamViNhiemVu` = VALUES(`NhomPhamViNhiemVu`),
    `TrangThai` = VALUES(`TrangThai`),
    `TrangThaiVietTat` = VALUES(`TrangThaiVietTat`),
    `TrangThaiVietTat2` = VALUES(`TrangThaiVietTat2`),
    `TenNhiemVu_Mobile` = VALUES(`TenNhiemVu_Mobile`),
    `syncdate` = VALUES(`syncdate`);
/* Xóa bản ghi không còn trong nguồn ở chu kỳ này */
DELETE FROM datamart_hanoi.qlnv_tonghop_chitiet_nhom_tiepnhan_new_rt WHERE syncdate < '${sync_ts}' OR syncdate IS NULL;

When transaction rollback happened, none of these FlowFiles would be routed to 'success'. If the <Rollback On Failure> is set true, these FlowFiles will stay in the input relationship. When the <Rollback On Failure> is set false,, if any of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry', all of these FlowFiles will be routed to 'retry'.Otherwise, they will be routed to 'failure'. sql-post-query.name: sql-post-query

Max Wait Time.name: Max Wait Time
Max Wait Time.description: The maximum amount of time allowed for a running SQL select query  , zero means there is no limit. Max time less than 1 second will be equal to zero.

dbf-normalize.name: dbf-normalize
dbf-normalize.description: Whether to change non-Avro-compatible characters in column names to Avro-compatible characters. For example, colons and periods will be changed to underscores in order to build a valid Avro record.

dbf-user-logical-types.name: dbf-user-logical-types
dbf-user-logical-types.description: Whether to use Avro Logical Types for DECIMAL/NUMBER, DATE, TIME and TIMESTAMP columns. If disabled, written as string. If enabled, Logical types are used and written as its underlying type, specifically, DECIMAL/NUMBER as logical 'decimal': written as bytes with additional precision and scale meta data, DATE as logical 'date-millis': written as int denoting days since Unix epoch (1970-01-01), TIME as logical 'time-millis': written as int denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch, and TIMESTAMP as logical 'timestamp-millis': written as long denoting milliseconds since Unix epoch. If a reader of written Avro records also knows these logical types, then these values can be deserialized with more context depending on reader implementation.

compression-format.name: compression-format
compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

properties.SQL select query:
/* [RT 12/11 full] ghi *_new_rt; TRUNCATE+INSERT → staging + RENAME swap */
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg LIKE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt;
TRUNCATE TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg;
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;
INSERT INTO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg 
SELECT
main.monthkey AS monthkey,
main.loaicapcha AS loaicapcha,
main.loaicap AS loaicap,
main.iddv AS iddv,
main.donvi AS donvi,
main.tenviettat AS tenviettat,
main.loaicapcha_dvthuchien AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
main.loaicap_dvthuchien AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
main.iddv_dvthuchien AS iddv_dvthuchien,
main.donvi_dvthuchien AS donvi_dvthuchien,
main.tenviettat_dvthuchien AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
main.VanBanGiaoNhiemVu AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
main.LinhVuc AS LinhVuc,
main.Kieu AS Kieu,
main.tongso AS tongso,
main.daht AS daht,
main.daht_dh AS daht_dh,
main.daht_qh AS daht_qh,
main.daht_kh AS daht_kh,
main.dangth AS dangth,
main.dangth_th AS dangth_th,
main.dangth_qh AS dangth_qh,
main.dangth_sqh AS dangth_sqh,
main.dangth_kh AS dangth_kh,
main.nhomvb_ma AS nhomvb_ma,
main.nhomvb AS nhomvb,
main.syncdate AS syncdate

FROM (
SELECT 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m') + 0 AS monthkey,
		CASE
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.AssignDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha,
		NULL AS loaicap,
    dv_giao.DepartmentId AS iddv,
    IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi,
    
		IFNULL(dv_giao.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat,
		
		CASE
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.695%'  THEN 'Thành ủy Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1775%' THEN 'HĐND Thành phố'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.1790%' THEN 'Ủy ban MTTQ Việt Nam thành phố Hà Nội'
				WHEN t.TargetDepartment LIKE '490.698%'  THEN 'UBND Thành phố'
				ELSE 'Khác'
		END AS loaicapcha_dvthuchien,
		NULL AS loaicap_dvthuchien,
    d.DepartmentId AS iddv_dvthuchien,
    IFNULL(d.DepartmentName ,'Chưa xác định') AS donvi_dvthuchien,
    
		IFNULL(d.DepartmentShortName ,'Chưa xác định')  AS tenviettat_dvthuchien,
		CASE
        WHEN t.DocCode LIKE "Số %" THEN REPLACE(t.DocCode,"Số ","")
				WHEN t.DocCode IS NOT NULL AND t.DocCode <> "" AND t.DocCode <> " " THEN t.DocCode
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS VanBanGiaoNhiemVu,
		s.SectorName AS LinhVuc,
		CASE
        WHEN r.Type = 1 THEN 'Chỉ thị'
        WHEN r.Type = 2 THEN 'Nghị quyết'
				WHEN r.Type = 3 THEN 'Công văn'
				WHEN r.Type = 4 THEN 'Kết luận'
				WHEN r.Type = 5 THEN 'Thông báo'
        ELSE 'Không xác định'
    END AS Kieu,

    /* Tổng số */
    COUNT(*) AS tongso,

    /* Nhóm đã hoàn thành (Status = 4) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  <= t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_dh,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (3,4) AND COALESCE(t.CompletedDate, t.ApprovedDate)  > t.ExpireDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS daht_qh,
		NULL as daht_kh,

    /* Nhóm đang thực hiện (Status in -1,0,1,2,3) */
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_th,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_qh,
		SUM(CASE WHEN t.Status IN (-1,0,1,2) AND t.ExpireDate >= NOW() AND DATEDIFF(t.ExpireDate, NOW()) <= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dangth_sqh,
		NULL AS dangth_kh,
		
		COALESCE(rg4.ResolutionGroupId,rg3.ResolutionGroupId,rg2.ResolutionGroupId,rg1.ResolutionGroupId,rg.ResolutionGroupId) AS nhomvb_ma,
		COALESCE(rg4.Name,rg3.Name,rg2.Name,rg1.Name,rg.Name)  AS nhomvb,
		NOW() AS syncdate

FROM db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_task t
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department d ON d.DepartmentIdExt = t.TargetDepartment
	LEFT JOIN datamart_hanoi.department dv_giao ON dv_giao.DepartmentIdExt = t.AssignDepartment
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution r ON t.ResolutionId = r.ResolutionId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_sector s ON s.SectorId = r.SectorId
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg ON r.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ResolutionGroupId -- mức 1: cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg1 ON rg1.ResolutionGroupId = rg.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg1.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 2: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg2 ON rg2.ResolutionGroupId = rg1.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg2.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 3: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg3 ON rg3.ResolutionGroupId = rg2.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg3.IsRoot = 0 -- mức 4: cha của cha
	LEFT JOIN db_theodoinv_hn.qlnv_resolution_group rg4 ON rg4.ResolutionGroupId = rg3.ParentGroupId 
	AND rg4.IsRoot = 0
WHERE
    t.Status <> 5
    AND t.DeletedDate IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(t.CompletedDate,t.ExpireDate,t.CreatedDate), '%Y%m'),
		t.AssignDepartment,
    t.TargetDepartment,
		t.DocCode
		) main
ORDER BY 
    monthkey,
    iddv;
/* đổi chỗ nguyên tử, chờ khóa tối đa 10s */
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 10;
RENAME TABLE datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__old, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt, datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__old TO datamart_hanoi.qlnv_th_tongquan_donvi_giaonv_new_rt__stg;
SET SESSION lock_wait_timeout = 31536000;

compression-format.description: Compression type to use when writing Avro files. Default is None.

dbf-default-precision.name: dbf-default-precision
dbf-default-precision.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'precision' denoting number of available digits is required. Generally, precision is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However undefined precision (0) can be returned from some database engines. 'Default Decimal Precision' is used when writing those undefined precision numbers.

dbf-default-scale.name: dbf-default-scale
dbf-default-scale.description: When a DECIMAL/NUMBER value is written as a 'decimal' Avro logical type, a specific 'scale' denoting number of available decimal digits is required. Generally, scale is defined by column data type definition or database engines default. However when undefined precision (0) is returned, scale can also be uncertain with some database engines. 'Default Decimal Scale' is used when writing those undefined numbers. If a value has more decimals than specified scale, then the value will be rounded-up, e.g. 1.53 becomes 2 with scale 0, and 1.5 with scale 1.

esql-max-rows.name: esql-max-rows
esql-max-rows.description: The maximum number of result rows that will be included in a single FlowFile. This will allow you to break up very large result sets into multiple FlowFiles. If the value specified is zero, then all rows are returned in a single FlowFile.

esql-output-batch-size.name: esql-output-batch-size
esql-output-batch-size.description: The number of output FlowFiles to queue before committing the process session. When set to zero, the session will be committed when all result set rows have been processed and the output FlowFiles are ready for transfer to the downstream relationship. For large result sets, this can cause a large burst of FlowFiles to be transferred at the end of processor execution. If this property is set, then when the specified number of FlowFiles are ready for transfer, then the session will be committed, thus releasing the FlowFiles to the downstream relationship. NOTE: The fragment.count attribute will not be set on FlowFiles when this property is set.

esql-fetch-size.name: esql-fetch-size
esql-fetch-size.description: The number of result rows to be fetched from the result set at a time. This is a hint to the database driver and may not be honored and/or exact. If the value specified is zero, then the hint is ignored.

esql-auto-commit.name: esql-auto-commit
esql-auto-commit.description: Enables or disables the auto commit functionality of the DB connection. Default value is 'true'. The default value can be used with most of the JDBC drivers and this functionality doesn't have any impact in most of the cases since this processor is used to read data. However, for some JDBC drivers such as PostgreSQL driver, it is required to disable the auto committing functionality to limit the number of result rows fetching at a time. When auto commit is enabled, postgreSQL driver loads whole result set to memory at once. This could lead for a large amount of memory usage when executing queries which fetch large data sets. More Details of this behaviour in PostgreSQL driver can be found in https://jdbc.postgresql.org//documentation/head/query.html.

relationships.name: failure
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated and retrying the operation will also fail, such as an invalid query or an integrity constraint violation

relationships.name: retry
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship if the database cannot be updated but attempting the operation again may succeed

relationships.name: success
relationships.description: A FlowFile is routed to this relationship after the database is successfully updated
